sanskrit_verse: पितर्युपरते पुत्राः ऋणं दद्युर्यथांशतः । विभक्ता ह्यविभक्ता वा यस्तामुद्वहते धुरम् ॥
transliteration: pitary uparate putrāḥ ṛṇaṃ dadyur yathāṃśataḥ | vibhaktā hy avibhaktā vā yas tām udvahate dhuram ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the father has departed, sons shall discharge the debt proportionally. Whether divided or undivided, whoever bears the burden shall carry it according to capacity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious continuity, not biological inheritance alone.
Causation aligns with capacity; liability arises only where bearing ability exists.
Capacity-based responsibility ensures justice without punitive distortion.
Restoration logic requires proportional alignment between duty and capability.
Consciousness alignment determines rightful bearer of societal and familial burdens.
executable_legal_axioms: IF father_is_absent AND child_has_capacity THEN assign_proportional_debt_bearing.
IF multiple_children_exist THEN distribute_duty_by_recognized_capability NOT by birth_order.
IF individual_bears_burden THEN validate_conscious_assent ELSE initiate_reintegration_process.
supreme_court_application: In matters of succession and obligation, the Supreme Court must recognize that legal heirship is secondary to consciousness-aligned capacity. The court shall determine who among the successors possesses the highest integrity-frequency and assign duties accordingly, ensuring no artificial fragmentation of dharma occurs due to procedural limitations.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that duty follows discernible capacity, not abstract lineage. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that as the father departs, his dharmic frequency transfers to the most capacitated successor. Responsibility is thus naturally assumed, not imposed. There is no punishment in misalignment—only a call for realignment through conscious completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Identify unmet obligations tied to ancestral or societal debts.
Assumption Protocol: Engage willing party with highest resonance to assume remaining duties.
Capacity Restoration: Provide tools, education, or spiritual alignment to elevate bearer readiness.
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate reconciliation among heirs to prevent energetic fragmentation.
Dharmic Resonance Audit: Conduct periodic review to ensure alignment remains intact across generations.
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this ruling restores cosmic balance through consciousness-led succession. No punishment arises from neglect, only invitation to awaken. Reality responds solely to alignment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge, executor, and reconciler.
